description: The latest stored ChainK9 report for a token on BNB Smart Chain, Ethereum, Base or Arc, without running a new scan; its tier field says whether it was a lite, full or ultra scan. Most funded new launches are scanned in the background within minutes of their first liquidity and re-scanned an hour later, so this is usually the fastest answer for a new token. Not charged if the token was never scanned on that chain (404). Costs $0.002 per successful call in USDC on Base, paid with x402 in the call's _meta; failed calls are free.

chain.description: bsc (BNB Smart Chain, the default), eth (Ethereum) or base (Base)

token.description: Token address on the chosen chain

name: report
